embedding_decision.distance_metric: cosine via descending dot product of L2-normalized float32 vectors

corpus_scope.retrieval: An enabled chat reads exactly one active-locale generation; cross-locale scan, fallback, merge, and ordinary-search calls are forbidden.

selected_backend.format: One locale-private contiguous little-endian float32 matrix plus canonical chunk-order metadata and a checksummed compatibility/integrity manifest.
selected_backend.algorithm: Exact descending dot-product scan over the active locale only; no approximate-nearest-neighbour graph, cross-locale fallback, hybrid retrieval, daemon, listener, or database server.
selected_backend.runtime_dependency: No vector-database extension. The concrete bounded numeric kernel is selected with M5-06 and must preserve this exact ordering contract.
selected_backend.promotion_and_recovery: Build a complete candidate generation in private staging, verify every file hash, shape, locale, compatibility key, and chunk order, then atomically promote. A missing, partial, corrupt, mixed, or stale generation is quarantined and retrieval abstains while M4 ordinary search remains ready.
selected_backend.migration_boundary: There is no in-place schema migration. A future backend or format change creates a new compatibility key and full replacement generation; the old verified generation remains active until atomic promotion.
rationale: The current and 10x locale-private corpus fits exact scan within the frozen retrieval budget without a new native vector-database component.
The byte format, ordering, reproducibility, per-locale isolation, checksum verification, and recovery path are directly controlled by BPM.
It avoids sqlite-vec's pre-v1 breaking-change and extension ABI/package risk on the supported local installation paths.

rejected_candidates.benchmark_role: Compared with the same deterministic vectors, query set, locale partitioning, top-k, and current/10x corpus scale.
rejected_candidates.rejection_reason: The upstream project declares the API pre-v1 with expected breaking changes. It adds a native loadable extension, binding/package and ABI verification, and a database recovery/migration surface without a required performance or scale benefit for this corpus.

acceptance.correctness: Both comparison candidates must return the same ordered top-k IDs for every deterministic query in each locale and scale; a candidate may never scan another locale.
acceptance.resource_policy: Offline generation may use swap under the accepted resource-policy amendment. Interactive retrieval limits and all non-swap release gates remain mandatory.
